children: CSB Financial's net interest income rose 7.0% year over year, while net loss was $119,000 compared with net income of $106,000. The loss primarily reflected a one-time $375,000 charitable contribution tied to the company's stock conversion and offering; net interest income growth was driven mainly by higher average interest-earning assets.
Revenue (net interest + noninterest income) was $1.04M, compared with $979.1K in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 6.7%.
Net income was ($119.27K), compared with $106.47K in the prior-year quarter; turned to loss.
: Increased to 3.56% from 3.51%, reflecting higher asset yields, partly offset by higher costs on interest-bearing liabilities.
: Fell 9.2% to $593,000, driven by lower average interest-bearing liabilities and a lower overall cost of funds.
: Was consistent at $40,000 year over year.
: Increased 46.8% to $1.2 million, primarily reflecting holding-company costs and the $375,000 charitable foundation contribution.
